name: SVR Poker Android
nextApkDrop: Only after the Android web game passes a stable playtest batch.
notes: Do not force testers to update the APK every phase.
Use the stable Android web route for ongoing game logic and UX updates.
Phase 333 preserves Phase 332 table authority, pass-line betting, chip gravity, denominations, and table-surface alignment.
Phase 333 adds Quest-safe physical shaders, environment reflections, controlled table lighting, an XR poker action bar, turn prompts, and automatic next-hand continuation.
A store route hook and multiplayer turn-change event are exposed as integration frameworks; payment and network authority are not enabled by this phase.
Quest/Oculus gameplay remains on the separate WebXR route; Android keeps its stable touch-first route.
Director preview remains separate and must contain no Android controls or visible runtime overlays.
Build a new native APK only when native app code, package, permissions, signing, icon, WebView shell, or release channel changes.
